# Languages — Wyatt's Notes

> Free, open-access study notes. Part of the Wyatt's Notes network at https://wyattsnotes.wyattau.com

Comparative programming language notes covering syntax, paradigms, type systems, and concurrency models across Dart, Go, Rust, Python, and more.

All pages are open-access, ad-free, and licensed under AGPLv3.

## Overview

- [About This Site](https://languages.wyattau.com/about/): About Wyatt's Notes Programming Languages resources, experience, expertise, and credentials behind programming language comparison study materials.
- [Programming Language Comparison Guide](https://languages.wyattau.com/hub/): Study notes for Programming Language Comparison Guide with worked examples, practice problems, and key concepts for exam preparation.
- [Programming Languages](https://languages.wyattau.com/): Comparative programming language notes covering syntax, paradigms, type systems, and concurrency models across Dart, Go, Rust, Python, and more.
- [Programming Languages Glossary, Key Terms](https://languages.wyattau.com/glossary/): Cross-language programming terminology: static vs dynamic typing, memory management models, concurrency primitives, and compilation strategies shared across modern languages.
